lines: All the countless, nameless people
A hollow bravado, a phantom mind, like a monster of things
With an open heart I house my life
The rest is an empty, meaningless human
Expectations gather, a life of inequality
No talent, a grand non‑daily
All parents equal, individuality erased
The memories I trace
Because I have no place to belong
Don’t just cry in the gap of a dream
I know exactly what face I should wear
But still, answer me
Purify the darkness, purify the darkness
When night’s veil falls, that’s the signal
We confront each other in a circling battle
Spit out any nonsense
Don’t stop yet, don’t stop yet
Born in this city, I am wiser than anyone, this true self
Now I only create the cursed future of the cursed me
Running, falling, clutching the unending pain
The world awaits this fleeting moment
Lyric emotions wobble like a bug
The penalty of a flaw that obeyed obediently
Only a death‑defending choice, love’s impermanence
Unable to raise my voice, still
A puppet’s oath‑less hundred‑demon parade
Linked like beads to the very end
Kick reality, calm the sea, don’t throw my life away
Soak in my inner fragility
I don’t know what face to wear
Now just answer me
Untie the five constants, untie the five constants
Weave uncertain voices into an idea
Cancel out, the emotions spin
Beyond that, a hand rises now
Just chase it, just chase it
Wishing to be stronger than anyone, even your destiny
Now, in the dim bottom of night
Fall deeper and deeper
Did I look clumsy
This is who I am now
Just a corpse that cannot become anything—laugh at it
I’ve even stopped fleeing from everything before me
Repeating the image
Go beyond imagination
Purify the darkness, purify the darkness
When night’s veil falls, that’s the signal
We confront each other in a circling battle
Spit out any nonsense
Don’t stop yet, don’t stop yet
Born in this city, I am wiser than anyone, this true self
Now I only create the cursed future of the cursed me
Running, falling, clutching the unending pain
The world awaits this fleeting moment
